question: Who among the following was the founder of the Banaras Gharana of the style of khayal singing?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Pandit Gopal Mishra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **The Banaras tabla gharana **was developed a little **over 200 years ago **by **Pandit Ram Sahai (1780–1826). **At the **age of nine**, Ram moved to Lucknow to become a disciple of **Modhu Khan **of the **Lucknow Gharana**.
 
• **Banaras Gharana **is **one of the six most common styles **of playing the **Indian tabla**.
 
• **Pandit Gopal Mishra (1921-1977) **was one of the **greatest sarangi players **of the **twentieth century**.
 
• He was the **younger brother (by fifteen years) of Hanuman Prasad Mishra **from whom he learned as well as from his father **Sur Sahai Mishra **and from the **eminent Banaras vocalist Bara Ram Das**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Ustad Inayat Khan** also known as **Nath Singh **was one of India's **most influential sitar and surbahar players** in the first decades of the 20th century.
 
• Delhi Gharana was founded by Sidhar Khan Dhadi in the early 18th Century. Sometimes referred to as the inventor of the tabla, **Sidhar Khan **Dhadi is the earliest available name associated with tabla in historical records. He was initially a pakhawaj player from the tradition of **Lala Bhavanidas**.
 
• The Bhendibazaar Gharana was founded around 1890 by **brothers Chhajju Khan, Nazir Khan, and Khadim Hussain Khan in the Bhendi bazaar area of Mumbai.**
